To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dominant structure (i.e. diagonal and μτ-blocks) of the neutrino matrix does not change under radiative corrections.

(1) The dominant structure of the matrix is preserved by radiative corrections; (2) SM and MSSM radiative corrections are small (few per cents); (3) Non-standard corrections can be large (up to 100%) and strongly modify the sub-dominant structure of the matrix.
radiative corrections can change the structure of neutrinos mass matrix.
